description: Defines the ProxyServer class for representing proxy server configurations, including proxy types, host, and port, with methods for creation, validation, and property checks.

classes.name: ProxyServer
classes.description: Represents an immutable proxy server with type, host, and port information.

methods.name: ProxyServer()
methods.description: Default constructor creating an invalid ProxyServer.

methods.name: FromSchemeHostAndPort
methods.description: Static methods to create ProxyServer from scheme, host, and port.

methods.name: GetHost
methods.description: Returns the host as a string.

methods.name: is_valid
methods.description: Checks if the proxy server configuration is valid.

methods.name: is_direct
methods.description: Checks if the proxy is a direct connection.

methods.name: is_http
methods.description: Checks if the proxy is HTTP.

methods.name: is_https
methods.description: Checks if the proxy is HTTPS.

methods.name: is_socks
methods.description: Checks if the proxy is SOCKS4 or SOCKS5.

methods.name: is_quic
methods.description: Checks if the proxy is QUIC.

methods.name: is_http_like
methods.description: Checks if the proxy uses HTTP-like protocols.

methods.name: is_secure_http_like
methods.description: Checks if the proxy is secure HTTP-like.

methods.name: host_port_pair
methods.description: Returns the host and port pair.

methods.name: Direct
methods.description: Returns a ProxyServer representing a direct connection.

methods.name: GetDefaultPortForScheme
methods.description: Returns default port for a given scheme.
